label: Revenue growth
basis: Mean of FY2025 and FY2026 revenue growth; constant aggregate growth, no segment forecast.
direction: Higher revenue; net cash effect depends on margin, capex and WC intensity.

label: Operating margin
basis: Mean FY2024–26 EBIT / revenue; normalizes recent operating results.
direction: Higher EBIT and after-tax earnings/FCF; gross margin held fixed.

label: Gross margin
direction: At fixed EBIT margin, reallocates COGS vs opex; changes inventory/payables cash drivers.

label: Effective tax rate
basis: Mean FY2024–26 effective tax rate; no tax benefit on forecast losses.
direction: Higher tax reduces net income and CFO, absent offsetting driver changes.

label: Cash capex / revenue
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Higher cash capex lowers FCF and increases PP&E.

label: Days sales outstanding
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Slower collections increase receivables and reduce CFO.

label: Days inventory outstanding
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Higher inventory days increase inventory and reduce CFO.

label: Days payable outstanding
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Higher payable days increase payables and CFO.

label: Deferred revenue / revenue
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Higher contract liabilities increase CFO as revenue grows.

label: Depreciation / opening PP&E
basis: FY2026 depreciation / ending PP&E applied to future opening PP&E; approximate cohort aging.
direction: At fixed EBIT, increases noncash CFO adjustment and reduces net PP&E.

label: Amortization / opening intangibles
basis: FY2026 amortization / ending intangibles applied to future opening intangibles.
direction: At fixed EBIT, increases noncash CFO adjustment and reduces intangibles.

label: Stock compensation / revenue
direction: At fixed EBIT, increases noncash CFO adjustment and paid-in equity.

label: Interest / opening debt & finance leases
basis: FY2026 reported nonoperating interest / ending long-term debt and finance leases; blended proxy, no explicit debt maturities.
direction: Higher opening-balance interest reduces earnings and CFO.

label: Dividends / net income
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Higher payouts reduce financing cash and equity.

label: Buybacks / net income
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Higher repurchases reduce financing cash and equity.

label: Finance lease additions / revenue
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Increases PP&E and lease liabilities; no immediate cash-capex FCF impact.

label: Lease principal / opening finance leases
basis: Latest FY2026 ratio; held constant as a simplifying planning assumption.
direction: Reduces cash and lease liabilities; increases financing cash outflow.

label: Minimum cash balance ($m)
basis: FY2026 cash; new modeled borrowing funds shortfalls. Marketable securities are held fixed in other assets.
direction: Higher liquidity target can require more borrowing; affects subsequent interest.
